summary: LanzaTech Global filed an 8-K reporting an October 14, 2026 Tranche 1 closing of a series of related recapitalization and deleveraging transactions at LanzaJet, a sustainable aviation fuel affiliate in which the Company holds a significant equity stake. LanzaJet issued $10 million of senior secured notes to Future Solution Investments, an entity affiliated with a large existing LanzaTech stockholder, under a facility permitting up to $25 million total; FPF guarantees. Investors exchanged FPF indebtedness, LanzaJet convertible notes, preferred stock and offtake rights for warrants to purchase senior-ranking LanzaJet preferred. LanzaTech also issued FSI-designated warrants on its own common stock. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch dilution from the LanzaTech warrant overhang, LanzaJet ownership reshuffling, and further tranche drawings against the $25 million cap.
